Local changes: utility import path; inline span roots for valid HTML in text/buttons.
Some legacy icon names map to the nearest available animated glyph.

chevrons-down-up and folder-lock also use the revision above. Supplemental pin, pin-off, eye-dashed, panel-bottom-close, droplets and database paths are from Lucide main (2026-11-01), converted to paths with the local animation protocol; see ../LUCIDE-LICENSE.
